parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 127 | 0.822 | 0.822
2 | 50.4 | 5.63 | 6.45
3 | 126 | 21.2 | 27.7
4 | 149 | 29.7 | 57.3
5 | 197 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: >57.3 m (Layer 5, resistive sandy aquifer; minor water-bearing potential in Layer 2 clayey-sand, 0.82–6.45 m)
Recommendation: Drill through the shallow clayey zone (6.45–27.7 m) and transitional sands (27.7–57.3 m) to reach the main, more resistive aquifer below 57.3 m; place well screens in this deeper sand unit for optimal yield and water quality.
